content: Redaction by exact-value matching silently stops matching whenever the secret is transformed: base64, URL encoding, JSON or Unicode escaping, whitespace reformatting, truncation, case change, or splitting across lines and fields. It also misses secrets that never pass through the redactor at all, such as exception tracebacks, non-string objects rendered by __str__, and third-party payload dumps. Guidance: redact at the final sink after formatting, register derived values, log responses by status code plus a field allowlist rather than wholesale, and test with canary credentials of the same shape.
